notes: Firmware 1.1.4 / Web 1.1.9 / broker: the MQTT owner never waits inside a stalled write (arduino-esp32 closed the socket after 5 s) - frames go out only when the socket is writable, control frames queue, periodic frames drop; reconnect ladder 0.5-1 s .. 60 s with equal jitter that resets only after a stable link; supervisor re-init no longer tears down a healthy link (unsigned beat/now race) and adds no backoff step; the daily firmware check waits while the Web is in use; config/reported is resumable, debounced and capacity-aware; advisory 'received' acks are shed first; Wi-Fi disconnect reasons are logged and a driver-reported failure ends the connect wait after 4 s; STA flap guard 3 s. Broker: a dropped device socket is announced as presence {online:false,state:'reconnecting'} for PRESENCE_GRACE_MS (75 s) before the final offline; Web shows 'KẾT NỐI LẠI', keeps the last data and holds one light click until the machine is back. Control/safety/thermal/OTA policy unchanged.
